title: HDF Evidence Package
description: Bundles references to all HDF documents for audit, authorization, and compliance review. Each content entry references a document by type, URI, and checksum for integrity verification.

packageId.description: Unique identifier for this evidence package. Optional in casual use, expected in production ATO submissions. Auto-generated if omitted during creation.

name.description: Human-readable name for this evidence package. Example: 'Enterprise Portal ATO Evidence - Q1 2026'.

description.description: Description of the evidence package's purpose and scope.

systemRef.description: URI to the hdf-system document this evidence package covers.

planRef.description: URI to the hdf-plan document that drove this assessment. Used for completeness verification — every baseline in the plan should have a corresponding results document in this package.

preparedBy.description: Identity of who prepared this evidence package.

preparedAt.description: When this evidence package was prepared. ISO 8601 format.

contents.description: References to HDF documents included in this evidence package.

externalEvidence.description: References to external native-format evidence (log/telemetry corpora and other artifacts) carried by URI + integrity hash + format discriminator, without recreating the data inside HDF. Logs in ECS/OCSF/etc. are legitimate accreditation evidence; HDF indexes them here rather than transcoding them.

completenessCheck.description: Summary of assessment completeness and compliance status.

signature.description: Digital signature covering the entire evidence package.

labels.description: Optional key-value labels for grouping and querying evidence packages.

integrity.description: Cryptographic integrity information for verifying this evidence package has not been tampered with.

generator.description: Information about the tool that generated this document.

Content_Type.description: The type of document referenced in the evidence package. 'bom' covers any Bill-of-Materials/manifest document (SBOM, AI model/dataset, and reserved future kinds) — its specific kind is carried by the referenced document's bomType, not by a per-kind Content_Type value.
Content_Type.title: Content Type

type.description: The type of HDF document being referenced.

uri.description: URI to the document. Can be a relative path or absolute URL.

checksum.description: Cryptographic checksum for verifying the referenced document's integrity.

description.description: Optional description of this content entry.

componentRef.description: componentId of the component this content entry relates to. Use to link SBOMs, results, or other documents to a specific system component.

Content_Reference.description: A reference to an HDF document or BOM/manifest included in the evidence package.
Content_Reference.title: Content Reference

External_Evidence_Format.title: External Evidence Format
External_Evidence_Format.description: The native format of the referenced external evidence. Reserved values are OPEN, referenceable, serialized standards: ecs (Elastic Common Schema), ocsf (Open Cybersecurity Schema Framework), cyclonedx, spdx, raw-log (unstructured/native logs). Custom or vendor-specific kinds MUST use an 'x-' prefix (e.g. 'x-splunk-export') so they cannot collide with a value later promoted into the reserved set. Adding a reserved value is a schema version bump.
External_Evidence_Format.$comment: Reserved values must be OPEN, serialized, uri+hash-referenceable artifacts. Query-time normalization MODELS are deliberately EXCLUDED because they have no portable stored artifact to reference: Splunk CIM is a search-time 'schema-on-the-fly' over Splunk-internal indexes, and Microsoft ASIM is a set of query-time KQL parsers over Sentinel tables. To carry Splunk/Sentinel-derived evidence, reference its EXPORTED result set (JSON/CSV/NDJSON) via an 'x-' format + mediaType — never the model name. 'schema-one' is intentionally NOT yet reserved: it has no open public spec (as of 2026-07), and reserving a value whose shape/version is unverified would violate the fixture-integrity rule; it will be added once the authoritative spec is obtained. Carriage is reference-only and never parses the payload, so a large/complex or spec-gated format (e.g. Schema One) is still referenceable as an opaque 'x-' value.

External_Evidence_Time_Range.title: External Evidence Time Range

start.description: Start of the time window the corpus covers (ISO 8601).

end.description: End of the time window the corpus covers (ISO 8601).

External_Evidence_Time_Range.description: The time window a referenced external evidence corpus covers.

External_Evidence_Metadata.title: External Evidence Metadata

recordCount.description: Approximate number of records/events in the referenced corpus.

timeRange.description: The time window the referenced evidence covers.

collector.description: The tool/pipeline that collected or produced the corpus. Example: 'aws-security-lake', 'elastic-agent'.

External_Evidence_Metadata.description: Descriptive metadata about a referenced external evidence corpus. Does not affect integrity.

uri.description: URI to the external native-format evidence artifact (log/telemetry corpus, etc.). Can be a relative path or absolute URL. The data stays canonical in its native format — HDF references it, never parses or transcodes it.

format.description: The native format discriminator of the referenced artifact.

checksum.description: Cryptographic checksum of the referenced artifact for integrity verification.
checksum.$comment: Strongly recommended for external evidence — a point-in-time reference without an integrity hash is weakly auditable. Kept out of `description` so this usage-specific note does not aggregate into the shared Checksum type's generated Go doc comment (quicktype concatenates $ref-sibling descriptions onto the referenced type).

mediaType.description: Optional IANA media type describing the on-disk serialization, orthogonal to 'format' (the semantic standard). Examples: application/x-ndjson, application/json, application/vnd.apache.parquet, text/csv.

formatVersion.description: Optional producer-declared version of the format (e.g. ECS '9.4.0', OCSF '1.8.0'). Free-text and untrusted — HDF does not validate it against a registry.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of this evidence entry.

metadata.description: Optional descriptive metadata about the referenced corpus. Does not affect integrity.

examples.$comment: ECS log corpus carried by reference (NDJSON) — HDF never parses it; the hash pins integrity.
OCSF telemetry landed as Parquet in a security data lake.
A Splunk export carried as an opaque x- custom format — CIM/ASIM are query-time models, so reference the EXPORT, not the model.

External_Evidence_Reference.description: A reference to external native-format evidence (log/telemetry corpus or other artifact) carried by URI + integrity hash + format discriminator. Reference-only: the artifact is never embedded (corpora can be huge) or transcoded (that would be lossy) — it stays canonical in its native format and HDF acts as the structured index.
External_Evidence_Reference.$comment: Deliberately distinct from two look-alike primitives — the shared DRY is the common Checksum type, not the container. Bom (boms[] on components/system) models component COMPOSITION and is richer: also embeddable (document) and normalizable into HDF's queryable shape (packages/model/dataset). Content_Reference (contents[]) references HDF-ECOSYSTEM documents and BOMs by Content_Type. External_Evidence_Reference is reference-only and OPAQUE (HDF never inspects it), for NATIVE non-HDF log/telemetry corpora indexed as accreditation evidence; it carries log-specific metadata (recordCount/timeRange/collector) the other two do not. Do not merge these — collapsing them would mix incompatible discriminator axes and lose Bom's normalization.
External_Evidence_Reference.title: External Evidence Reference

componentsWithSbom.description: Number of system components that have an associated SBOM.

totalComponents.description: Total number of components in the system.

SBOM_Coverage.description: SBOM coverage statistics for the system.
SBOM_Coverage.$comment: This metric intentionally measures SOFTWARE (SBOM) inventory coverage only. Coverage accounting for ai-model/dataset/other BOM kinds is deliberately out of scope for now; a future generalized bomCoverage metric may be added. This is a distinct software-inventory metric, not an oversight of the Content_Type 'sbom'->'bom' generalization — do not rename or generalize it.
SBOM_Coverage.title: SBOM Coverage

allBaselinesAssessed.description: Whether all baselines referenced by system components have assessment results.

allComponentsCovered.description: Whether all system components have at least one matching target in the results.

expiredWaivers.description: Number of waivers/amendments that have expired.

unresolvedPoams.description: Number of POA&M items that are still open (not completed).

compliancePercent.description: Overall compliance percentage across all assessments.

sbomCoverage.$comment: Intentionally software-inventory (SBOM) coverage only; ai-model/dataset/other BOM kinds are out of scope for this metric for now.

Completeness_Check.description: Informational summary of assessment completeness. Not authoritative — tools should compute these from the referenced documents.
Completeness_Check.title: Completeness Check
